title: Episode 32
logline: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 31's cliffhanger where Catherine used a glowing branding iron to scorch Juliana's mother's herbal book.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.00)
Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.00)
Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.80)
Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.80)
Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:03.00) | End: (00:04.50)
Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:03.00) | End: (00:04.50)
Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:04.50) | End: (00:07.50)
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:04.50) | End: (00:07.50)
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:07.50) | End: (00:10.50)
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:07.50) | End: (00:10.50)
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Taunting):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:09.80) | End: (00:13.20)
"You have been so proud of that brave little face..."

Start: (00:10.50) | End: (00:13.50)
Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:10.50) | End: (00:13.50)
Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Smug, Dominant):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:13.40) | End: (00:15.80)
"...but now you are afraid."

Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:16.00)
Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:16.00)
Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:16.00) | End: (00:17.00)
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:16.00) | End: (00:17.00)
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Cruel, Final):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:16.20) | End: (00:18.80)
"Say goodbye to your mother."

Start: (00:17.00) | End: (00:19.00)
Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:17.00) | End: (00:19.00)
Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:20.50)
Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:20.50)
Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:19.00) | End: (00:20.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:19.00) | End: (00:20.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:20.50) | End: (00:23.00)
Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:20.50) | End: (00:23.00)
Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:23.00) | End: (00:25.50)
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:23.00) | End: (00:25.50)
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:25.50) | End: (00:28.50)
Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:25.50) | End: (00:28.50)
Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Firm, Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:25.80) | End: (00:28.80)
"Burn the ledger. Burn every page."

Start: (00:28.50) | End: (00:30.80)
Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:28.50) | End: (00:30.80)
Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Steely, Proud):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:32.80)
"You may destroy the book..."

Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:33.50)
Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:30.80) | End: (00:33.50)
Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:33.50) | End: (00:36.50)
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:33.50) | End: (00:36.50)
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Transcendent, Defiant):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:33.20) | End: (00:36.20)
"...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."

Start: (00:36.40) | End: (00:38.80)
Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:36.40) | End: (00:38.80)
Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Spiteful, Hissing):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:36.40) | End: (00:39.10)
"You think a few herbs make you better than me?"

Start: (00:38.80) | End: (00:41.00)
Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:38.80) | End: (00:41.00)
Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:39.20) | End: (00:42.80)
"No. Your cruelty does that for me."

Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:43.50)
High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:43.50)
High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:43.50) | End: (00:45.50)
Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:43.50) | End: (00:45.50)
Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Furious, Shouting):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:43.40) | End: (00:45.40)
"You still think you are better?!"

Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:47.80)
Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:47.80)
Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Serene, Grounded):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:45.60) | End: (00:47.40)
"I know what I am."

Start: (00:47.80) | End: (00:49.00)
Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:47.80) | End: (00:49.00)
Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Sneering, Mocking):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:47.80) | End: (00:49.00)
"A disgraced woman?"

Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.50)
Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.50)
Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Unwavering):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:49.20) | End: (00:52.40)
"A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."

Start: (00:52.50) | End: (00:54.40)
Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:52.50) | End: (00:54.40)
Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Screaming, Enraged):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:52.80) | End: (00:54.20)
"You are lying!"

Start: (00:54.40) | End: (00:58.00)
Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:54.40) | End: (00:58.00)
Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Measured, Emphatic):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:54.60) | End: (00:58.00)
"Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."

Start: (00:58.00) | End: (01:00.80)
Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:58.00) | End: (01:00.80)
Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Contemplative, Scathing):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:01.00)
"He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."

Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:04.50)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:04.50)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Passionate, Clear):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:01.10) | End: (01:06.80)
"He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him."

Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:07.00)
Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:07.00)
Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:07.00) | End: (01:09.00)
Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:07.00) | End: (01:09.00)
Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Unapologetic, Victorious):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:07.20) | End: (01:08.90)
"Let him have Clarissa."

Start: (01:09.00) | End: (01:11.20)
Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:09.00) | End: (01:11.20)
Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:11.20) | End: (01:13.30)
Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:11.20) | End: (01:13.30)
Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Shrieking, Vicious):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:11.30) | End: (01:13.20)
"You were rejected!"

Start: (01:13.30) | End: (01:15.50)
Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:13.30) | End: (01:15.50)
Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:13.40) | End: (01:17.60)
"I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."

Start: (01:15.50) | End: (01:17.50)
Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:15.50) | End: (01:17.50)
Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:17.50) | End: (01:20.00)
Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:17.50) | End: (01:20.00)
Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Disdainful):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:17.80) | End: (01:19.40)
"Your soldier?"

Start: (01:20.00) | End: (01:22.50)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:20.00) | End: (01:22.50)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:24.10)
Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:24.10)
Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Bitter):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:22.50) | End: (01:24.00)
"He is a nobody."

Start: (01:24.10) | End: (01:26.50)
Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:24.10) | End: (01:26.50)
Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Warm, Defiant):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:24.20) | End: (01:26.20)
"Then I love a nobody."

Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:29.80)
Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:29.80)
Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Resonant, Moving):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:26.50) | End: (01:30.20)
"Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did."

Start: (01:29.80) | End: (01:32.80)
Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:29.80) | End: (01:32.80)
Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:30.10) | End: (01:32.60)
"You know nothing about my world."

Start: (01:32.80) | End: (01:37.00)
Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:32.80) | End: (01:37.00)
Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Knowing, Sober):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:33.20) | End: (01:36.60)
"I know exactly what your world values."

Start: (01:37.00) | End: (01:39.80)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:37.00) | End: (01:39.80)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Listing, Deliberate):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:37.60) | End: (01:39.60)
"Beauty. Money."

Start: (01:39.80) | End: (01:41.00)
Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:39.80) | End: (01:41.00)
Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:41.00) | End: (01:43.70)
Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:41.00) | End: (01:43.70)
Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Firm):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:43.50)
"Family. A perfect name."

Start: (01:43.70) | End: (01:47.00)
Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:43.70) | End: (01:47.00)
Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Continuing):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:43.80) | End: (01:47.20)
"And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."

Start: (01:47.00) | End: (01:48.80)
Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:47.00) | End: (01:48.80)
Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:47.20) | End: (01:48.80)
"And what is wrong with that?!"

Start: (01:48.80) | End: (01:49.40)
Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:48.80) | End: (01:49.40)
Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:49.40) | End: (01:52.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking serene.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:49.40) | End: (01:52.50)
Close-up of Juliana looking serene.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:49.50) | End: (01:52.80)
"Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."

Start: (01:52.50) | End: (01:56.00)
Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:52.50) | End: (01:56.00)
Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Unrelenting):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:52.80) | End: (01:56.00)
"You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow..."

Start: (01:56.00) | End: (01:56.80)
Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:56.00) | End: (01:56.80)
Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:56.80) | End: (01:59.50)
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:56.80) | End: (01:59.50)
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Piercing):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:56.90) | End: (01:59.50)
"...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you."

Start: (01:59.50) | End: (02:01.80)
Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:59.50) | End: (02:01.80)
Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:59.60) | End: (02:01.80)
"Silence! Silence!"

Start: (02:01.80) | End: (02:03.00)
Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:01.80) | End: (02:03.00)
Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.

blocks.text:
Start: (02:02.80) | End: (02:05.00)
Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:02.80) | End: (02:05.00)
Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Forceful):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:03.00) | End: (02:05.20)
"Because I am right!"

Start: (02:05.00) | End: (02:08.50)
Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:05.00) | End: (02:08.50)
Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Scathing, Direct):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:05.40) | End: (02:08.80)
"You want everyone to believe you are powerful."

Start: (02:08.50) | End: (02:11.80)
Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:08.50) | End: (02:11.80)
Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Continuing):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:09.00) | End: (02:11.60)
"You want everyone to fear you."

Start: (02:11.80) | End: (02:14.80)
Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:11.80) | End: (02:14.80)
Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Mocking, Direct):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:12.00) | End: (02:14.00)
"But look at you."

Start: (02:14.80) | End: (02:18.50)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:14.80) | End: (02:18.50)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Stripping Her Bare):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:15.00) | End: (02:18.60)
"You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"

Start: (02:18.50) | End: (02:20.40)
Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:18.50) | End: (02:20.40)
Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Choking with Rage):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:18.60) | End: (02:20.20)
"You insolent—!"

Start: (02:20.40) | End: (02:22.40)
Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:20.40) | End: (02:22.40)
Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Steely, Triumphant):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:20.40) | End: (02:22.30)
"You may have the title you have always wanted..."

Start: (02:22.40) | End: (02:26.50)
Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:22.40) | End: (02:26.50)
Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Final, Condemning):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:22.40) | End: (02:26.50)
"...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."

Start: (02:26.50) | End: (02:28.00)
Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:26.50) | End: (02:28.00)
Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Enraged, Shouting):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:26.60) | End: (02:28.10)
"You think you can lecture me?!"

Start: (02:28.00) | End: (02:30.80)
Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:28.00) | End: (02:30.80)
Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.

blocks.text:
Start: (02:28.00) | End: (02:30.80)
Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
blocks.action:
Start: (02:28.00) | End: (02:30.80)
Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Screaming, Maniacal):
blocks.text:
